moments.author: Jensen Huang
moments.quote: I’d be honored to return as CEO if the board asks.
moments.why: A high‑stakes corporate comeback plot with geopolitical and tech‑industry implications has men buzzing.

moments.author: Steven Cheung
moments.quote: "Fake News! President Trump was looking at papers… You can clearly see his eyes move back and forth."
moments.why: A defensive rebuttal to viral footage of Trump appearing to nod off at an international summit is dominating male‑targeted political discourse.

moments.author: Margo Martin
moments.quote: @POTUS and President Xi watch a performance of YMCA ❤️
moments.why: A bizarrely choreographed Cold‑War‑style welcome video, now meme fodder, is sparking wide attention.

moments.author: Pete Hegseth
moments.quote: She has proven herself to be a dedicated patriot and professional… confident she will advance President Trump’s America First agenda.
moments.why: A new cyber chief appointment after major U.S. service outages is a trending issue in national‑security and tech circles.
